title: Edit notebook
description:
Edit part of a notebook's content by short_id.

For markdown notebooks, use `execute-sql` to read the current markdown from `system.notebooks.markdown`, then edit with `old_markdown` / `new_markdown`. These are plain markdown strings; do not copy or construct the nested `ph-markdown-notebook` JSON wrapper.

For legacy rich-text notebooks, inspect the JSON content from `system.notebooks.content`, then edit with `old_value` / `new_value` JSON subtree replacement. Matching is by content: the tool finds `old_value` anywhere in the notebook and swaps it for `new_value` in place.

On success, returns the updated notebook with the new content and bumped version. On a 409 or 410 error, the notebook has changed since you loaded it; reload the latest markdown or JSON content and re-apply your edit.
